title: Sherman family haunted off the ranch

tellings.quote: in the 90s a family named the shermans took over the ranch and were basically haunted off the property they encountered orbs ufos skin walkers and even got rushed by an oversized bipedal wolf that they claimed was able to withstand a close range attack from a shotgun

plain: In the 1990s a family named the Shermans took over Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch in Utah known for reports of strange events, and were, as Michels puts it, basically haunted off the property. They reported orbs, UFOs and skinwalkers, the shape-shifters of Native American legend, and said they were rushed by an oversized wolf walking on two legs that took a close-range shotgun blast and kept going. Michels tells it himself as the family's own account.
